mechanism: Diclofenac may increase deutetrabenazine exposure through CYP2D6 inhibition and reduce renal clearance of metabolites, while NSAIDs increase risk of GI bleeding and cardiovascular events in patients taking CNS-active medications.
action: Monitor for increased deutetrabenazine side effects (sedation, orthostatic hypotension, akathisia); consider alternative analgesia; ensure gastroprotection if NSAID use necessary.
